readme:
# Bring a Trailer Scraper

Get auction listings from [Bring a Trailer](https://bringatrailer.com/): the auctions that are open now, or completed results with the sold price. The actor returns one record per listing: title, year, make and model, current bid or final price, end time, location, reserve status, comment count, images and more. No login and no API key are needed.

## What you get

- Two modes. `live` reads every auction that is open now, soonest ending first. `completed` reads finished auctions, newest first.
- One record per listing, saved 24 at a time.
- Filters for keywords, country, no-reserve auctions and, for completed results, sold or not sold.
- Each listing once per run. A run that is interrupted continues where it stopped. Listings already delivered are not delivered or charged again.
- You pay only for listings that were saved to the dataset.

## Use with AI agents (MCP)

Connect this actor to any MCP-compatible AI client, such as Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code, LangChain or LlamaIndex.

**MCP server URL:**

```
https://mcp.apify.com?tools=santamaria-automations/bringatrailer-scraper
```

**Example prompt once connected:**

> "Use `bringatrailer-scraper` to list the live Porsche 911 auctions that end in the next two days with their current bid and location as a CSV."

## Data extracted

| Field | Example |
|-------|---------|
| `listing_id` | `124628828` |
| `url` | `"https://bringatrailer.com/listing/2003-porsche-911-carrera-4-cabriolet-41/"` |
| `title` | `"LS376-Powered 2003 Porsche 911 Carrera 4 Cabriolet"` |
| `year`, `make`, `model` | `2003`, `"Porsche"`, `"911 Carrera 4 Cabriolet"` (read from the title, empty when not clear) |
| `status` | `"live"`, `"sold"`, `"reserve_not_met"`, `"withdrawn"` or `"ended"` |
| `price`, `price_kind`, `price_text`, `currency` | `40250`, `"sold_price"`, `"USD $40,250"`, `"USD"` (`current_bid` for a live auction, `high_bid` when the reserve was not met) |
| `has_bids` | live auctions only: `false` while bidding is open and no bid was placed |
| `end_time`, `end_timestamp` | `"2026-11-06T22:19:09Z"`, `1794003549` |
| `result_text` | `"Sold for USD $40,250 on 11/6/2026"` |
| `comment_count`, `view_count`, `watcher_count` | counts, when the site shows them |
| `country`, `country_code` | `"United States"`, `"US"` |
| `latitude`, `longitude` | location coordinates, when the site shows them (live auctions) |
| `no_reserve`, `premium`, `relisted` | `true`, `false`, `false` |
| `thumbnail_url`, `image_url`, `images` | list image, at list size and at full size |
| `excerpt` | short description from the site |
| `category_ids`, `era` | category numbers and decade, for live auctions |
| `vin` | VIN or chassis number, when it appears in the listing keywords |
| `keywords` | keyword text the site attaches to a live listing |
| `mode`, `page`, `scraped_at` | how and when the row was read |

Fields that the site does not show for a listing are returned empty.

## Pricing

Pay-per-event pricing. You pay only for listings that were saved to the dataset.

| Event | Price |
|-------|-------|
| Actor start (`actor-start`) | $0.001 per run |
| Listing scraped (`listing-result`) | $0.003 per listing ($3.00 per 1,000) |

The start event is charged once per run, together with the first saved listing. A run that returns nothing is not charged. If you set a maximum cost per run, the actor stops before it goes over that limit.

## Input

| Field | Type | Description | Default |
|-------|------|-------------|---------|
| `mode` | string | `live` or `completed`. | `live` |
| `keywords` | string[] | Only listings that match one of these terms in the title, description or keywords. Every word of a term must be found, for example `"porsche 911"`. Empty returns all. | none |
| `countryCode` | string | Two letter country of the vehicle, for example `US`, `CA`, `GB`, `DE`. Empty includes all. | all |
| `noReserveOnly` | boolean | Only auctions without a reserve price. | `false` |
| `outcome` | string | Completed mode only: `all`, `sold` or `unsold`. | `all` |
| `maxItems` | integer | Most listings to return. 0 uses 100. | `100` |
| `maxPages` | integer | Completed mode only: most pages of 24 results to read. 0 uses 40. | `40` |

## Usage examples

### Live Porsche 911 auctions

```json
{
  "mode": "live",
  "keywords": ["porsche 911"],
  "maxItems": 48
}
```

### The latest 120 completed auctions

```json
{
  "mode": "completed",
  "maxItems": 120
}
```

### Sold Ferraris from the last results, no reserve

```json
{
  "mode": "completed",
  "keywords": ["ferrari"],
  "outcome": "sold",
  "noReserveOnly": true,
  "maxItems": 50,
  "maxPages": 100
}
```

### All live auctions in Germany

```json
{
  "countryCode": "DE",
  "maxItems": 500
}
```

## Output

Results are saved to the default dataset. Export them as JSON, CSV or Excel, or read them through the API.

```json
{
  "listing_id": 124628828,
  "url": "https://bringatrailer.com/listing/2003-porsche-911-carrera-4-cabriolet-41/",
  "title": "LS376-Powered 2003 Porsche 911 Carrera 4 Cabriolet",
  "year": 2003,
  "make": "Porsche",
  "model": "911 Carrera 4 Cabriolet",
  "status": "sold",
  "price": 40250,
  "price_kind": "sold_price",
  "currency": "USD",
  "end_time": "2026-11-06T22:19:09Z",
  "result_text": "Sold for USD $40,250 on 11/6/2026",
  "comment_count": 0,
  "country_code": "US",
  "no_reserve": true,
  "premium": false,
  "image_url": "https://bringatrailer.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/IMG_5574-b389b90f4374ef2bfb65820ef102c23b.jpg",
  "mode": "completed",
  "page": 1
}
```

## Limitations

- The site shows its full set of live auctions on one page, so a live run makes a single request. Completed results come 24 per page and go back many years. Reading far back takes many pages; raise `maxPages` for that.
- Keywords, country and no-reserve filters are applied to the listings the actor reads. In completed mode a narrow filter can leave few matches per page, so such a run may read all `maxPages` pages and return fewer than `maxItems`.
- Make and model are read from the title, so they are empty when the title does not name a make the actor knows, and the model can include extra words from the title.
- Category numbers, decade, keywords and coordinates are published for live auctions only. Completed results do not carry them.
- The number of bids, the bid history, the comments, seller names and bidder names are not returned. Seller type is not shown in the list data.
- A live auction without a bid has an empty price and `has_bids` set to `false`.
- Live data is a snapshot. Bids and end times change while an auction runs.

## FAQ

**How many listings can I get?**
A live run returns all open auctions, around a thousand at a time. Completed results go back to the first years of the site. Set `maxItems` to the number you need.

**How do I get sold prices?**
Use `mode` `completed`. Rows with status `sold` carry the final price in `price`. Rows with status `reserve_not_met` carry the highest bid.

**Why is `price` empty for some live auctions?**
Bidding is open on those auctions and nobody has bid yet.

**What does a run cost?**
The pricing table shows a start fee plus a price per listing. A run of 48 listings costs a start fee plus 48 listings.

**What status does a run end with?**
The run status says how many listings were delivered. If the site refuses every request, the run fails and nothing is charged. If the filters match nothing, the run ends normally and says so.

**Does it need an account?**
No. The actor reads the same public lists that the Bring a Trailer auction pages show.
